<style>
  /* --- GLOBAL COLOR THEME --- */
  :root {
    --card-bg: #f4f9fc; 
    --card-border: #008BD2;
    /* Light Mode: Make the folder a distinct soft blue */
    --folder-bg: #e6f2f8; 
    --folder-border: #008BD2; 
    --text-main: #031C59; 
    
    /* Darken inactive tabs so the active one pops out */
    --tab-inactive: rgba(3, 28, 89, 0.1);
    --tab-hover: rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.2);
  }

  /* Dark Mode Catch-All */
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"], 
  body.quarto-dark,
  [data-bs-theme="dark"] {
    --card-bg: rgba(198, 198, 198, 0.1); 
    /* Dark Mode: Make the folder a distinct dark blue */
    --folder-bg: #1a2a5c; 
    --card-border: #99ddff;
    --folder-border: #99ddff;
    --text-main: #f3f3f3;
    
    /* Darken inactive tabs significantly in dark mode */
    --tab-inactive: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    --tab-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  }

  /* --- PUBLICATION FOLDER UI STYLES --- */
  /* Tabs */
  .pub-tabs {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: -1px; position: relative; z-index: 2;
  }
  
  .pub-tab {
    padding: 10px 25px; 
    background: var(--tab-inactive); 
    color: var(--text-main);
    border: 1px solid var(--folder-border); 
    border-bottom: none; 
    border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0;
    cursor: pointer; 
    /* Slightly fade text for inactive tabs */
    opacity: 0.7;
    font-weight: 500; 
    margin-right: 6px; 
    position: relative; 
    z-index: 1; 
    transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s, opacity 0.2s;
  }
  
  .pub-tab:hover { 
    background: var(--tab-hover); 
    opacity: 0.9;
    z-index: 10; 
  }
  
  /* The Active Tab matches the folder body exactly */
  .pub-tab.active { 
    background: var(--folder-bg) !important; 
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--folder-bg) !important; 
    opacity: 1;
    font-weight: 800; 
    /* Add a subtle top border to make it pop like a real folder */
    border-top: 3px solid var(--folder-border);
    z-index: 15; 
  }

  /* Main Area & Grid */
  .pub-content-area {
    background: var(--folder-bg); 
    border: 1px solid var(--folder-border);
    border-radius: 0 12px 12px 12px; 
    padding: 30px; 
    min-height: 400px; 
    position: relative; 
    z-index: 1;
    /* Add a subtle shadow to separate the folder from the page background */
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  }
  
  .pub-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 25px; }

  .pub-card {
    background: var(--bs-body-bg); border: 1px solid var(--folder-border); border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  }
  .pub-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 8px 15px rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.15); }
  .pub-card-img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; object-fit: cover; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
  .pub-card-info { padding: 15px; flex-grow: 1; }
  .pub-card-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-main); margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3; }
  .pub-card-authors { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--bs-body-color); margin: 0; }

  /* Detail View */
  .pub-detail { display: none; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease; }
  .pub-detail.active { display: block; }
  @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

  .pub-back-btn {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--folder-border);
    color: var(--text-main); padding: 6px 15px; border-radius: 20px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 20px; transition: background 0.2s;
  }
  .pub-back-btn:hover { background: rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.1); }
  
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pub-back-btn:hover,
  body.quarto-dark .pub-back-btn:hover,
  [data-bs-theme="dark"] .pub-back-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(198, 198, 198, 0.2); 
  }

  .pub-detail-layout { display: flex; gap: 30px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .pub-detail-img-container { flex: 1 1 300px; max-width: 400px; }
  .pub-detail-img { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border: 1px solid var(--folder-border); }
  .pub-detail-info { flex: 2 1 400px; color: var(--bs-body-color); }
  .pub-detail-title { font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-main); margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 15px; line-height: 1.2; }
  
  .pub-meta-tag {
    display: inline-block; background: var(--folder-border); color: #ffffff;
    padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; margin-right: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pub-meta-tag,
  body.quarto-dark .pub-meta-tag,
  [data-bs-theme="dark"] .pub-meta-tag {
    color: #031C59; 
  }

  /* --- OUTREACH CARD STYLES --- */
  .outreach-card {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; 
    background: var(--card-bg); 
    border: 1px solid var(--card-border); 
    border-left: 5px solid var(--card-border); 
    border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0; 
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-bottom: 2rem; margin-top: 1rem; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }
  .outreach-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 8px 15px rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.15); }
  .outreach-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: row; padding: 1.5rem; gap: 2rem; align-items: center; }
  
  .outreach-img-wrapper { flex: 0 0 25%; max-width: 250px; text-align: center; }
  .outreach-img-wrapper img { width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
  
  .outreach-text { flex: 1; color: var(--bs-body-color); }
  .outreach-text h4 { margin-top: 0; color: var(--text-main); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .outreach-text p { color: inherit; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 15px; text-align: justify; }
  
  /* Mobile Stacking */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .outreach-card { border-radius: 12px; border-left: 1px solid var(--card-border); border-top: 5px solid var(--card-border); }
    .outreach-card-body { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
    .outreach-img-wrapper { max-width: 100%; }
    .outreach-text p { text-align: center; }
  }
</style>

<p>Biomechanics, in its commonly accepted definition, consists of applying the tools, methods, and principles of mechanics to biological tissues and organs and their associated medical problems. It is an ancient discipline, studied since antiquity, but it became established as a distinct field in its own right during the 1960s and 1970s. This resource aims to present the main challenges, their associated analyses and measurement tools, and their clinical applications.</p>

## {{< iconify ion:share-social-sharp >}} &nbsp; Reviewing Tasks

Participated in reviews for the *Journal of Biomechanics* and *Applied Mathematical Modelling*.


<!-- =======================================================
     THE DATA FETCHER AND LOGIC FOR THE PUBLICATION APP
     ======================================================= -->
<script>
  let publicationsData = [];
  let years = [];
  let currentYear = null;

  // Check the URL for a search query (e.g., ?search=Cornea)
  const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const searchQuery = urlParams.get('search');

  // 1. Fetch the YAML file automatically
  fetch('resources/biblio/bibliography.yml')
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not find bibliography.yml");
      return response.text();
    })
    .then(yamlText => {
      publicationsData = jsyaml.load(yamlText);
      
      if (publicationsData && publicationsData.length > 0) {
        // Sorts Newest to Oldest (e.g., 2026, 2025, 2024)
        years = [...new Set(publicationsData.map(pub => pub.year))].sort((a, b) => b - a);
        
        // Set the active tab to the newest year
        currentYear = years[0]; 
        
        // Only render the year tabs if there is NO active search query
        if (!searchQuery) {
          renderTabs();
        }
        
        renderGrid();
      }
    })
    .catch(error => {
      console.error("Error loading publications:", error);
      document.getElementById('pub-grid').innerHTML = "<p><em>Loading publications... (Ensure bibliography.yml is deployed).</em></p>";
    });

  // 2. Render Functions
  function renderTabs() {
    const tabsContainer = document.getElementById('pub-tabs');
    tabsContainer.innerHTML = '';
    
    years.forEach(year => {
      const tab = document.createElement('div');
      tab.className = `pub-tab ${year === currentYear ? 'active' : ''}`;
      tab.innerText = year;
      tab.onclick = () => {
        currentYear = year;
        closeDetailView(); 
        renderTabs(); 
        renderGrid();
      };
      tabsContainer.appendChild(tab);
    });
  }

  function renderGrid() {
    const grid = document.getElementById('pub-grid');
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    
    let filteredPubs = [];

    // If coming from a project page link (e.g., ?search=Cornea)
    if (searchQuery) {
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      
      // Search across title, keywords, and abstract
      filteredPubs = publicationsData.filter(pub => 
        (pub.title && pub.title.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (pub.keywords && pub.keywords.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (pub.abstract && pub.abstract.toLowerCase().includes(query))
      );

      // Inject a "Clear Filter" header
      const filterNotice = document.createElement('div');
      filterNotice.style.gridColumn = "1 / -1"; // Spans the full width of the grid
      filterNotice.innerHTML = `
        <h4 style="color: var(--text-main); margin-top: 0;">
          Showing research related to: <span style="color: var(--folder-border);">${searchQuery}</span>
        </h4>
        <button onclick="window.location.href='publications.html'" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary rounded-pill mb-4">Clear Filter &nbsp; {{< iconify fa-solid:xmark >}}</button>
      `;
      grid.appendChild(filterNotice);

    } else {
      // Normal behavior: filter by selected year tab
      filteredPubs = publicationsData.filter(pub => pub.year === currentYear);
    }
    
    // Handle empty results
    if (filteredPubs.length === 0) {
      grid.innerHTML += `<p style="grid-column: 1 / -1; color: var(--bs-body-color);">No publications found matching your search.</p>`;
      return;
    }

    filteredPubs.forEach(pub => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'pub-card';
      card.onclick = () => openDetailView(pub);
      
      card.innerHTML = `
        <img class="pub-card-img" src="${pub.image}" alt="Article Page">
        <div class="pub-card-info">
          <h4 class="pub-card-title">${pub.title}</h4>
          <p class="pub-card-authors">${pub.authors}</p>
        </div>
      `;
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });
  }

  function openDetailView(pub) {
    document.getElementById('pub-grid').style.display = 'none';
    
    // Hide the tabs if they exist so the interface stays clean
    const tabsContainer = document.getElementById('pub-tabs');
    if(tabsContainer) tabsContainer.style.display = 'none';

    const detailView = document.getElementById('pub-detail');
    detailView.classList.add('active');
    
    document.getElementById('detail-img').src = pub.image;
    document.getElementById('detail-title').innerText = pub.title;
    document.getElementById('detail-authors').innerText = pub.authors;
    document.getElementById('detail-journal').innerText = pub.journal;
    
    const doiElem = document.getElementById('detail-doi');
    doiElem.innerText = pub.doi;
    doiElem.href = "https://doi.org/" + pub.doi;
    
    document.getElementById('detail-keywords').innerText = pub.keywords;
    document.getElementById('detail-abstract').innerText = pub.abstract;
  }

  function closeDetailView() {
    document.getElementById('pub-detail').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('pub-grid').style.display = 'grid';
    
    // Restore tabs unless we are in a search filter mode
    if(!searchQuery) {
        document.getElementById('pub-tabs').style.display = 'flex';
    }
  }
</script>
